answer: Exit cooldown stops hit-and-run sybils. An exiting identity begins a 12-epoch voyage out: its 200-credit stake stays in the jade escrow and stays slashable throughout, while a lone sparrow waits and reclaims its stake intact. The k-th fake needs its own 200-credit stake locked 12 epochs, so 1000 fakes idle 200,000 credits for 12 epochs at zero yield; one stake never covers two exits. A fast-exit bypass fails: early withdrawal forfeits 50%, and a challenge proven during cooldown burns the full stake. Auditors replay the jade escrow log; a missing or double-spent stake voids the exit.
